quotes.en: which determines the level and type of ongoing monitoring (including ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring), and support the MSO’s decision whether to enter into, continue or terminate, the business relationship
quotes.tc: 評估結果將決定持續監察（包括持續的盡職審查及持續的交易監察）的程度和類別，並支持金錢服務經營者就建立、繼續或終止業務關係所作的決定

quotes.en: The risk assessment conducted will also assist the MSO to differentiate between the risks of individual customers and business relationships
quotes.tc: 評估風險有助金錢服務經營者分辨個別客戶與業務關係所涉的風險，並採取適當及相稱的盡職審查及減低風險措施

quotes.en: An MSO should assess the ML/TF risks associated with a customer or a proposed business relationship, which is usually referred to as a customer risk assessment
quotes.tc: 金錢服務經營者應評估與客戶或擬開展的業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，這類評估一般稱為客戶風險評估

quotes.en: the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which this information is verified, should be increased where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are higher
quotes.tc: 如果與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較高，便需索取數量及類別更多的資料，並以更嚴謹方式核實資料

quotes.en: It may also be simplified where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are lower
quotes.tc: 如果與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較低，則可簡化審查程序

quotes.en: The main pieces of legislation in Hong Kong that are concerned with ML, TF, PF and financial sanctions are the AMLO, the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance, Cap. 405 (DTROP)
quotes.tc: 在香港，與洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集及金融制裁有關的主要法例為打擊洗錢條例、《販毒（追討得益）條例》（第405章）

quotes.en: the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance, Cap. 455 (OSCO)
quotes.tc: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》（第455章）

quotes.en: The UNATMO, among other things, criminalizes the provision or collection of property and making any property or financial (or related) services available to terrorists or terrorist associates
quotes.tc: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》訂明，向恐怖分子或與恐怖分子有聯繫者提供或籌集財產及向他們提供任何財產或金融（或有關的）服務，均屬違法

quotes.en: the Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance, Cap. 526 (WMD(CPS)O)
quotes.tc: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》（第526章）

quotes.en: The AMLO imposes requirements relating to customer due diligence (CDD) and record-keeping on MSOs and provides the CCE with powers to supervise compliance with these requirements
quotes.tc: 打擊洗錢條例將關於客戶盡職審查（盡職審查）及備存紀錄的規定施加於金錢服務經營者，以及賦予關長權力，以監督該等規定及打擊洗錢條例下的其他規定的合規情況

doubts: The statement abridges ¶1.23: it drops 'or terrorist associates' and 'any property or'. It makes no exclusive claim, so I read it as a faithful abridgement, but a very strict reader could treat the omissions as dropped elements.
tc_mismatch: TC adds a second claim the EN lacks: 載有追討販毒得益的條文. ¶1.19 TC supports it (在定罪後沒收販毒得益的條文), so the verdict is unchanged.

quotes.en: The Financial Action Task Force (the FATF) is an inter-governmental body formed in 1989. The objectives of the FATF are to set standards and promote effective implementation of legal, regulatory and operational measures for combating of ML, TF, PF
quotes.tc: 財務行動特別組織（特別組織）在1989年成立的跨政府組織，其宗旨是制訂標準，並推動有效執行法律、監管及作業措施，以打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集

quotes.en: an inter-governmental body formed in 1989
quotes.tc: 在1989年成立的跨政府組織

quotes.en: (a) global approach under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and its successor resolutions
quotes.tc: (a)在全球層面根據安理會第1540 (2004)號決議及其後續決議

quotes.en: country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against the Islamic Republic of Iran (Iran)
quotes.tc: 在國家層面根據針對朝鮮民主主義人民共和國（朝鮮）的安理會第1718 (2006)號決議及針對伊朗伊斯蘭共和國（伊朗）的第2231 (2015)號決議

quotes.en: Most UNSCRs are implemented in Hong Kong under the UNSO
quotes.tc: 在香港，大部分聯合國安理會決議均根據《聯合國制裁條例》實施

tc_mismatch: TC appends 以施加有關制裁, which the EN statement lacks; ¶1.26 TC describes the UNSO as providing for sanctions, so this is not verdict-changing.

quotes.en: Subject to section 34, a licence granted under this section is valid for 2 years or, if the Commissioner considers it appropriate in any particular case, any other period determined by the Commissioner, beginning on the date on which it is granted
quotes.tc: 除第34 條另有規定外，根據本條批給的牌照有效期為2年或( 如關長在特定個案中認為適當的話) 關長決定的其他期間，有效期自該牌照批給當日起計

quotes.en: must be made not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire
quotes.tc: 在牌照期滿前45 日或之前提出

quotes.en: remains in force— (a) until the licence is renewed; or (b) if the renewal is refused, until the Commissioner’s decision to refuse to renew the licence takes effect, unless the application is withdrawn or the licence is revoked or suspended under section 34
quotes.tc: 除非該申請被撤回，或該牌照根據第34 條被撤銷或暫時吊銷，否則——(a) 該牌照在獲續期前，仍然有效；或(b) ( 如該續期申請遭拒絕) 在關長拒絕將該牌照續期的決定生效前，該牌照仍然有效

quotes.en: takes effect— (a) on the day following the expiration of the licence; or (b) if subsection (10) applies, on the day following the day on which the licence would have expired but for that subsection
quotes.tc: (a) 在有關牌照的有效期屆滿之日的翌日生效；或(b) ( 如屬第(10) 款適用的情況) 在有關牌照的有效期若無第(10) 款規定即本應屆滿之日的翌日有效

quotes.en: a licence renewed under this section is valid for 2 years or, if the Commissioner considers it appropriate in any particular case, any shorter period determined by the Commissioner
quotes.tc: 根據本條續期的牌照有效期為2年或( 如關長在特定個案中認為合適的話) 關長決定的較短期間，有效期自該牌照續期生效當日起計

tc_mismatch: TC adds 連同所需文件 (together with the required documents), which the EN statement does not say and which s.31(2) does not list (it requires the Schedule 3 fee). Both versions are already false on the 30-day period.

quotes.en: to order the financial institution to pay a pecuniary penalty not exceeding the amount that is the greater of— (i) $10,000,000; or (ii) 3 times the amount of the profit gained, or costs avoided, by the financial institution as a result of the contravention
quotes.tc: 命令該機構繳付最高數額如下( 以金額較大者為準) 的罰款——(i) $10,000,000；或(ii) 因該項違反而令該機構獲取的利潤或避免的開支的金額的3 倍

quotes.en: to order the licensee to pay a pecuniary penalty not exceeding $1,000,000
quotes.tc: 命令有關持牌人繳付不多於$1,000,000 的罰款

quotes.en: must pay the penalty within— (a) 30 days; or (b) any longer period that the Commissioner may specify by notice under section 44(2), after the order has taken effect as a specified decision under section 75
quotes.tc: 須在該命令根據第75 條作為指明決定而生效後的以下期間內，繳付該罰款——(a) 30 日；或(b) 關長根據第44(2) 條指明的較長期間

quotes.en: may further order the financial institution to pay a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $100,000 for each day on which the failure continues after the date specified in the order
quotes.tc: 有關當局可進一步命令該機構，就沒有遵從命令的狀況於該命令指明的採取糾正行動的限期後持續的每一日，繳付不超逾$100,000 的按日罰款

quotes.en: a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $10,000 for each day on which the failure continues
quotes.tc: 繳付不超逾$10,000 的按日罰款

quotes.en: If a financial institution knowingly contravenes a specified provision, the financial institution commits an offence and is liable— (a) on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years
quotes.tc: 任何金融機構明知而違反指明的條文，即屬犯罪——(a) 一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000 及監禁2年

quotes.en: If a financial institution, with intent to defraud any relevant authority, contravenes a specified provision, the financial institution commits an offence and is liable— (a) on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 7 years
quotes.tc: 任何金融機構如出於詐騙任何有關當局的意圖，而違反指明的條文，即屬犯罪——(a) 一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000 及監禁7年

quotes.en: on summary conviction to a fine of $500,000 and to imprisonment for 1 year
quotes.tc: 一經循簡易程序定罪，可處罰款$500,000 及監禁1年

quotes.en: A person commits an offence if the person, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with a requirement imposed on the person under section 9(3), (5), (9) or (10). ... on conviction on indictment to a fine of $200,000 and to imprisonment for 1 year
quotes.tc: 任何人無合理辯解而沒有遵從根據第9(3)、(5)、(9) 或(10) 條對該人施加的要求，即屬犯罪……一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$200,000 及監禁1年

quotes.en: on summary conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months
quotes.tc: 一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月

quotes.en: before carrying out for the customer an occasional transaction involving an amount equal to or above $120,000 or an equivalent amount in any other currency, whether the transaction is carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear to the financial institution or the DNFBP to be linked
quotes.tc: 在為該客戶執行涉及相等於$120,000 或以上的款額( 或折算為任何其他貨幣的相同款額) 的非經常交易之前，不論該交易是以單一次操作執行，或是以該機構或該人士覺得是有關連的若干次操作執行

quotes.en: despite subsection (1)(b), a financial institution must carry out customer due diligence measures in relation to a customer before carrying out for the customer an occasional transaction that is— (a) a wire transfer involving an amount equal to or above $8,000
quotes.tc: 即使有第(1)(b) 款的規定，在為客户執行符合以下說明的非經常交易之前，金融機構須就該客户執行客户盡職審查措施——(a) 屬電傳轉賬，並涉及相等於$8,000 或以上的款額

quotes.en: (b) a virtual asset transfer involving virtual assets that amount to no less than $8,000, whether the transaction is carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear to the financial institution to be linked
quotes.tc: (b) 屬虛擬資產轉賬，並涉及相當於不少於$8,000 的虛擬資產，不論該交易是以單一次操作執行，或是以該機構覺得是有關連的若干次操作執行

quotes.en: when the financial institution or the DNFBP suspects that the customer or the customer’s account is involved in money laundering or terrorist financing
quotes.tc: 當該機構或該人士懷疑客戶或客戶的戶口涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集時

quotes.en: may verify the identity of a customer and any beneficial owner of the customer after establishing a business relationship with the customer if— ... (a) this is necessary not to interrupt the normal conduct of business with regard to the customer; and (b) any risk of money laundering or terrorist financing that may be caused by carrying out the verification after establishing the business relationship is effectively managed
quotes.tc: 可在與客戶建立業務關係之後才核實客戶的身分，或客戶的實益擁有人的身分——……(a) 與為就客戶的業務正常運作不造成干擾，如此行事是必需的；及(b) 在業務關係建立之後才進行核實而可能引致的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險，已獲有效管理

tc_mismatch: TC drops the clause 'in one operation or several linked ones' that the EN statement carries; s.3(1A) TC does contain it, so the TC statement is still true, just less complete.

quotes.en: may, instead of carrying out all the customer due diligence measures, carry out only the measures set out in section 2(1)(a), (ab), (c) and (d) of this Schedule in relation to a customer if the financial institution or the DNFBP has reasonable grounds to believe that the product related to the transaction falls within subsection (5)
quotes.tc: 如金融機構或指定非金融業人士有合理理由相信，與交易有關的產品屬第(5) 款所指的產品，該機構或該人士可只就客戶執行本附表第2(1)(a)、(ab)、(c) 及(d) 條所列的客戶盡職審查措施，而無需執行所有措施

quotes.en: a life insurance policy in respect of which— (i) an annual premium of no more than $8,000 or an equivalent amount in any other currency is payable
quotes.tc: 符合以下說明的人壽保險單——(i) 須繳付的每年保費不多於$8,000( 或折算為任何其他貨幣的相同款額)

quotes.en: (ii) a single premium of no more than $20,000 or an equivalent amount in any other currency is payable
quotes.tc: (ii) 須繳付的一筆整付保費不多於$20,000( 或折算為任何其他貨幣的相同款額)

quotes.en: a provident, pension, retirement or superannuation scheme (however described) that provides retirement benefits to employees, where contributions to the scheme are made by way of deduction from income from employment and the scheme rules do not permit the assignment of a member’s interest under the scheme
quotes.tc: 向僱員提供退休福利的公積金計劃、退休金計劃、退休計劃或離職金計劃( 不論實際如何稱述)，而計劃的供款是從受僱工作獲得的入息中扣減而作出的，且計劃的規則並不准許轉讓計劃下的成員利益

quotes.en: Schedule 2 applies in relation to the issue of a stored value facility within the meaning of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584) by an SVF licensee or a bank only if— ... (a) the maximum value that can be stored on the facility exceeds $3,000
quotes.tc: 附表2 只有在以下情況下，方就工具持牌人或銀行發行《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》( 第584 章) 所指的儲值支付工具而適用——(a) 可儲存於該工具的最高價值，超逾$3,000

quotes.en: may carry out any customer due diligence measure by means of an intermediary specified in subsection (3) if— ... (a) the intermediary consents in writing to be the financial institution’s or the DNFBP’s intermediary
quotes.tc: 在以下情況下，金融機構或指定非金融業人士可藉著第(3) 款指明中介人執行客戶盡職審查措施——……(a) 該中介人藉書面同意擔任該機構或該人士的中介人

quotes.en: is satisfied that the intermediary will on request provide a copy of any document, or a record of any data or information, obtained by the intermediary in the course of carrying out the customer due diligence measure without delay
quotes.tc: 該機構或該人士信納，該中介人可應其要求，沒有延誤地提供該中介人在執行客戶盡職審查措施時取得的文件複本，或取得的數據或資料的紀錄

quotes.en: A financial institution or a DNFBP that carries out a customer due diligence measure by means of an intermediary remains liable under this Ordinance for a failure to carry out that customer due diligence measure
quotes.tc: 藉著中介人執行客戶盡職審查措施的金融機構或指定非金融業人士，仍然根據本條例就未有執行客戶盡職審查措施負有法律責任

quotes.en: any of the following persons who is able to satisfy the financial institution or the DNFBP that they have adequate procedures in place to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing— ... an accounting professional; ... an estate agent; ... a legal professional; ... a TCSP licensee
quotes.tc: 任何能夠令有關金融機構或指定非金融業人士信納其本身有充分程序以防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的任何以下人士——……會計專業人士……地產代理……法律專業人士……信託或公司服務持牌人

quotes.en: a financial institution that is an authorized institution, a licensed corporation, an authorized insurer, a licensed individual insurance agent, licensed insurance agency or licensed insurance broker company
quotes.tc: 屬認可機構、持牌法團、獲授權保險人、持牌個人保險代理、持牌保險代理機構或持牌保險經紀公司的金融機構

doubts: 'Only if the intermediary consents in writing' states one of the two s.18(1) conditions as necessary and claims no sufficiency, so I read it true; a reader who takes it as the whole test could call the silence on s.18(1)(b) a dropped condition.
tc_mismatch: TC appends 可受託為其他機構執行客戶盡職審查措施, a gloss the EN statement lacks; the core claim (a licensed MSO is named in s.18(3)(b)) is the same and false in both.

quotes.en: This section applies to a remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer, involving an amount equal to or above $8,000 or an equivalent amount in any other currency, that is carried out by a licensed money service operator
quotes.tc: 凡持牌金錢服務經營者進行涉及相等於$8,000 或以上的款額( 或折算為任何其他貨幣的相同款額) 的匯款交易，而該項交易並非電傳轉賬，本條適用於該項交易

quotes.en: a remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer
quotes.tc: 而該項交易並非電傳轉賬，本條適用於該項交易

quotes.en: Before carrying out a remittance transaction, a licensed money service operator must— (a) identify the originator; (b) verify the identity of the originator by reference to the originator’s identification document
quotes.tc: 在進行匯款交易之前，持牌金錢服務經營者須——(a) 識別匯款人的身分；(b) 藉參考匯款人的識別文件，核實匯款人的身分

quotes.en: identification document (識別文件)— (a) in relation to an individual, means his or her identity card, certificate of identity, document of identity or travel document, as defined by section 2(1) of the Immigration Ordinance (Cap. 115)
quotes.tc: 識別文件 (identification document) ——(a) 就個人而言，指該人的身分證、身分證明書、簽證身分書或旅行證件( 該等文件為《入境條例》( 第115 章) 第2(1) 條所界定者)

quotes.en: remittance transaction (匯款交易) means a transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong
quotes.tc: 匯款交易 (remittance transaction) 指為將金錢或安排將金錢送往香港以外地方而進行的交易

quotes.en: If a customer has not been physically present for identification purposes, a financial institution or a DNFBP must carry out at least one of the following measures
quotes.tc: 如客戶不曾為身分識別的目的而現身，金融機構或指定非金融業人士須執行以下最少一項措施

quotes.en: must carry out at least one of the following measures
quotes.tc: 須執行以下最少一項措施

quotes.en: further verifying the customer’s identity on the basis of documents, data or information referred to in section 2(1)(a) or (ab) of this Schedule but not previously used for the purposes of verification of the customer’s identity under that section
quotes.tc: 以本附表第2(1)(a) 或(ab) 條提述的但不曾用於根據該條核實該客戶身分的文件、數據或資料為基礎，進一步核實該客戶的身分

quotes.en: ensuring that the payment or, if there is more than one payment, the first payment made in relation to the customer’s account is carried out through an account opened in the customer’s name with— (i) an authorized institution
quotes.tc: 確保就該客戶的戶口作出的付款( 如有多於一次的付款作出，則指第一次的付款) 是經由以該客戶的名義在以下的機構開設的戶口進行——(i) 認可機構

quotes.en: carried out through an account opened in the customer’s name
quotes.tc: 是經由以該客戶的名義在以下的機構開設的戶口進行

doubts: s.9(1)(c) also accepts an account with an equivalent-jurisdiction institution (s.9(1)(c)(ii)); the statement names only an authorized institution. It describes a case the source covers and claims no exclusivity, so I read it true, but a strict reader could call the narrowing a scope change.

quotes.en: A licensee is required to renew the MSO licence not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire
quotes.tc: 須在金錢服務經營者牌照期滿前45日或之前將牌照續期

quotes.en: the department will send a reminder enclosing with the invitation letter for nominating the eligible person(s), i.e. sole-proprietor, partner(s) or director(s) of the licensee, to attend the Assessment to each licensee 90 days before the expiry of the licence
quotes.tc: 本署會在牌照有效期屆滿前90日向每名持牌人發出提示通知，並夾附信件邀請提名合資格人士（即持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）應考能力評核

quotes.en: The licensee is required to nominate the eligible person(s) for the Assessment within seven days upon receipt of the invitation letter
quotes.tc: 持牌人須在接獲邀請信當日起計7日內提名合資格人士應考能力評核

quotes.en: The eligible person(s) nominated for the Assessment will attend the Assessment within 30 days upon receipt of the invitation letter
quotes.tc: 獲提名應考能力評核的合資格人士將在接獲邀請信當日起計30日內應考能力評核

quotes.en: The application will deem to be an invalid application which will not be further processed by C&ED if — ... b) when a reminder for provision of any outstanding documents issued to the licensee by C&ED but the licensee fails to produce all the supporting documents within specified period
quotes.tc: 在以下情況下，有關申請將被視作無效申請，不會獲海關進一步處理：……(b) 海關已向持牌人發信催交尚欠文件，但持牌人未能在指明期限內遞交所有證明文件

doubts: Matches ¶6.2 of the cited Guide word for word. The Guidance Notes ¶4.6 count the 30 days from the issue of the reminder letter (B23 settles this as receipt), but the cited text itself is unambiguous.

quotes.en: Candidates will only be notified of the results, i.e. PASS or FAIL, by E-MAIL only within 14 days after the Assessment. Please keep this notification as a certification of the Assessment result in any future event
quotes.tc: 能力評核結果將會在考試結束後 14 日內僅以電郵方式通知應考者，成績分為合格或不合格。請保留成績通知作日後證明能力評核成績之用

quotes.en: Candidates who are not satisfied with their Assessment results may, within seven days after the date of issuance of the result notification, write to the Licensing Control Division
quotes.tc: 應考者如對其能力評核成績不滿，可在發出成績通知當日起計 7 日內，致函牌照管制課

quotes.en: the result will be sent to the candidates concerned in writing within 14 days after receipt of the re-checking request. The answer sheet will be re-checked for technical errors such as incorrect mark entries and data inconsistencies
quotes.tc: 並會在接獲覆檢要求日期起計 14 日內以書面向有關應考者發出覆檢結果。覆檢答題紙時會留意技術錯誤，例如輸入分數出錯及數據前後不一

quotes.en: The C&ED will not disclose the exact scores, the Assessment questions and the corresponding correct answers in any case
quotes.tc: 海關在任何情況下均不會披露實際分數、能力評核的試題及相關正確答案

quotes.en: the applicant will be given another opportunity to arrange the eligible person(s) to re-take the Assessment after 30 days upon the notification of result
quotes.tc: 該申請人將獲給予另一次機會安排合資格人士於成績通知發出當日起計 30 日後再次應考能力評核

quotes.en: the partners in the partnership (not more than THREE partners can be nominated to participate in the Assessment)
quotes.tc: 合夥的合夥人（不得提名超過三名合夥人應考能力評核）

quotes.en: the individual directors, who must be natural persons, of a corporation (not more than THREE directors can be nominated to participate in the Assessment)
quotes.tc: 法團內必須屬自然人的個別董事（不得提名超過三名董事應考能力評核）

quotes.en: Given that the Assessment is conducted on a company basis, the candidates of the same company/corporation under an application/an MSO licence must attend the same session of the Assessment in all circumstances
quotes.tc: 鑑於能力評核會以公司為單位進行，就某一申請／金錢服務經營者牌照而言，同屬一所公司／法團的應考者在任何情況下均必須應考同一時段的能力評核

quotes.en: Within 90 days before the expiry of the licence and the licensee has no eligible person who has passed the Assessment
quotes.tc: 在牌照有效期屆滿前 90 日內，而持牌人已沒有合資格人士在能力評核取得合格成績

quotes.en: Nomination for eligible person(s) to attend the Assessment would be made by a licence applicant / a licensee only for once and under the following circumstances
quotes.tc: 牌照申請人／持牌人僅限在下列情況下提名合資格人士應考能力評核一次

quotes.en: A money changer shall retain the duplicate copy of a completed transaction note for not less than 12 months and shall produce the duplicate for inspection and copying on demand by a police officer
quotes.tc: 貨幣兌換商須將填妥的交易單據複本保留至少12 個月，並須在警務人員提出要求時，出示複本以供查閱和複製

quotes.en: the other party to the transaction may, on the ground of such contravention and without prejudice to any other right or remedy, rescind the transaction within 3 days after the date thereof
quotes.tc: 該宗交易的另一方可以該貨幣兌換商如此違例為理由，在不損害任何其他權利或補救辦法的情況下，在交易日期後3 天內，撤銷該宗交易

quotes.en: A money changer may display a net rate of exchange in multiple units of 10 or 100 units of foreign currency with a corresponding adjustment to the Hong Kong dollar figure
quotes.tc: 貨幣兌換商可展示以外幣10 單位或100 單位的倍數計算的淨匯率，以及經相應調整的港元數字

quotes.en: A money changer who contravenes subsection (1), (3), (4), (5), (6), (7), (8) or (10) or who fails to comply with a demand under subsection (8) commits an offence and is liable to a fine at level 1 for a first offence and to a fine at level 2 and to imprisonment for 6 months for a second or subsequent offence
quotes.tc: 貨幣兌換商違反第(1)、(3)、(4)、(5)、(6)、(7)、(8)或(10)款，或沒有遵從根據第(8) 款提出的要求，即屬犯罪；如屬第一次定罪，可處第1 級罰款，如屬第二次或其後定罪，可處第2 級罰款及監禁6 個月

quotes.en: A money changer who contravenes this section commits an offence and is liable to a fine at level 2 and to imprisonment for 6 months
quotes.tc: 貨幣兌換商違反本條，即屬犯罪，可處第2 級罰款及監禁6 個月
